data.define: To wear many layers because it's cold.

misuse.text: Don't tell a friend to 'bundle up' in summer.
misuse.why: It means put on warm clothes.

data.l1_hook: Il fait un froid glacial dehors. Prêt à "bundle up" ?
data.l1_ex: "Bundle up", il fait un froid glacial dehors !

native.tip: “bundle up” = s'emmitoufler. Exemple: “Bundle up, it's freezing outside!”
